fields.description: Turn the AI Assistant on or off for all users.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Base URL of the provider API. For Ollama use http://PRIVATE_OLLAMA_IP:11434/v1
fields.label: API URL / Base URL

fields.description: Stored encrypted on the server. Never sent to the browser. Not needed for Ollama.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Models of the selected provider. After saving with the API Key, the provider's full live list is shown. Any other model id can also be typed.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Not sent to Claude (current Claude models do not accept it).
fields.label: Temperature

fields.description: Seconds to wait for the provider per request.
fields.label: Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Optional. Only AI provider requests use this proxy, e.g. http://172.17.0.1:3128 (see docker/egress_proxy.py). Leave empty for a direct connection.
fields.label: HTTPS Proxy

fields.description: Native uses the provider's function calling. Use Prompt JSON for models that do not support tools.
fields.label: Tool Calling Mode

fields.description: How many recent messages are sent to the AI as conversation context.
fields.label: Max Conversation Messages

fields.description: Only users with at least one of these roles can use the assistant. Leave empty to allow all desk (System) users.
fields.label: Allowed Roles

fields.description: Replaced by Allowed Roles; kept only so older data can be moved there.
fields.label: Allowed Role (old)

fields.description: AI tokens (prompt + answer) one user may use per day; 0 = no limit. Keeps the cost of a paid provider in check.
fields.label: Tokens per User per Day

fields.description: The provider and model above are the company default that every user gets. Here you decide what users may change for themselves (AI Assistant page > AI Model).
fields.label: User's Own Provider / Model

fields.description: Users can pick OpenRouter, OpenAI, Claude or Gemini with their own API key (official API URLs only; their key is stored encrypted and is never shown again).
fields.label: Users Can Choose Their Own Provider / Model

fields.description: Without their own key, can users switch to another model of the company provider on the company's API key? Free models only = no extra cost (OpenRouter free models). Any model = they spend company credit. Not allowed = their own key is needed for any change.
fields.label: Other Models on Company Key
fields.options:
Free models only
Any model
Not allowed

fields.description: Leave empty to use the built-in prompt. Server-side security rules and the tool catalog are always added by the server and cannot be removed here.
fields.label: System Prompt
